title: Generalizing Causal Decision-Making: Markov Equivalence, Transportability and Counterfactuals
abstract: arXiv:2611.14066v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Structural causal bandits use causal knowledge to guide exploration when reward mechanisms are unknown. This paper extends the approach to partially known causal structure, information from other environments, and realizable counterfactual actions. First, we develop graphical criteria for minimal intervention sets under Markov equivalence and characterize possibly-optimal minimal intervention sets for maximal ancestral graphs. A search algorithm finds sets that are possibly optimal in at least one graph represented by a partial ancestral graph. Second, we derive target reward bounds from source distributions through partial transportability, accounting for non-manipulable variables. Dominance relations provide further bounds for action pruning and restricted exploration, with a regret guarantee under valid prior bounds. Third, we formulate counterfactual structural causal bandits over actions supported by specified experimental capabilit

translated_title: 泛化因果决策：马尔可夫等价性、可迁移性与反事实
translated_abstract: 结构因果老虎机在奖励机制未知时，利用因果知识来指导探索。本文将该该方法扩展至部分已知的因果结构、来自其他环境的信息以及可实现的反事实行动。首先，我们在马尔可夫等价性下发展了最小干预集的图判别准则，并刻画了极大祖先图中可能最优的最小干预集；提出了一种搜索算法，用以找到在偏祖先图所表示的至少一个图中可能最优的干预集。其次，我们通过部分可迁移性从源分布推导出目标奖励的边界，并考虑了不可操纵变量；支配关系为动作剪枝和受限探索提供了进一步的边界，并在有效先验边界下具有遗憾保证。第三，我们在由指定实验能力所支持的行动上构建了反事实结构因果老虎机。
tldr: 本文将结构因果老虎机推广至三种更一般的场景——通过马尔可夫等价性刻画部分已知因果结构下可能最优的最小干预集、利用部分可迁移性从源环境推导目标奖励边界并获得遗憾保证、以及构建支持反事实行动的反事实结构因果老虎机框架。
en_tdlr: This paper generalizes structural causal bandits in three directions: characterizing possibly-optimal minimal intervention sets under Markov equivalence for partially known causal structures, deriving target reward bounds with regret guarantees via partial transportability across environments, and formulating counterfactual structural causal bandits over actions supported by specified experimental capabilities.
